items.quote: I was actually planning to write this for years! Because I’ve been approached literally every day by one or another startup.
items.statement: I was actually planning to write this for years!

items.quote: Not because they’re so successful and companies are actively using them. The opposite.
items.statement: AI voice solutions have gone quiet lately.

items.quote: It’s because they don’t understand it on a deeper level, and that’s why - don’t actually have a product - that solves a problem that people are ready to Pay for.
items.statement: Founders do not understand the market on a deeper level.

items.quote: The only thing you haven’t done is proper customer development with actual market insiders.
items.statement: You should engage in proper customer development with actual market insiders.

items.quote: And the reason nobody does this is they think they’re saving the cost and they’ll learn from their own mistakes.
items.statement: Many believe they are saving costs by avoiding market research.

items.quote: But for everyone else, maybe it’s time to rethink where you’re putting your investment.
items.statement: Rethink where you’re putting your investment if results are lacking.

overview: A LinkedIn post advising PropTech founders on strategies for succeeding in the Dubai real estate market.
